description: Partial update for an existing `PluginConfig`. APISIX recursively merges object fields, replaces arrays, and removes an object field when its value is `null`. The merged resource is then validated against the complete `PluginConfig` schema.

id.description: Unique identifier for the resource. Can be a string (1–64 characters, alphanumeric with `-`, `_`, `.`) or a positive integer.

labels.description: Key-value pairs for categorizing and filtering resources. Values must be non-empty strings (max 256 characters).

update_time.description: Unix timestamp of last update. Read-only.
